# Andrews-Curtis Conjecture Challenge

> Andrews-Curtis Conjecture Challenge. The elementary moves on balanced
> presentations, a verifier that replays a submitted trivialisation and
> refuses one it cannot finish, and a measured baseline search, for the
> SAIR Foundation competition.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
